text: While walking alone, a mysterious stranger approaches you and offers to share a shortcut through an unfamiliar alley. They seem friendly, but something feels off.

choices.text: Follow the stranger into the alley.
choices.bad_outcome_text: The alley is a trap. The stranger leads you into danger and you lose your belongings. Strangers cannot always be trusted, no matter how friendly they seem.
choices.good_outcome_text: You make it through safely this time, but it was a lucky escape. Following strangers into unknown places is rarely wise.

choices.text: Politely decline and stick to the main road.
choices.bad_outcome_text: The main road takes much longer and you arrive late, frustrating the team.
choices.mid_outcome_text: You arrive on time. Choosing safety over convenience was the right call — you never know a stranger's true intentions.
choices.good_outcome_text: You arrive early and feel confident in your decision. Trusting your instincts and avoiding unknown risks pays off.
